scripts.build: npm run validate:schema && tsc && vite build
scripts.mobile:client:sync: npm run mobile:client:config && npm run build:mobile && cap sync
scripts.mobile:guard:sync: npm run mobile:guard:config && npm run build:mobile && cap sync
scripts.build:mobile: npm run validate:schema && tsc && vite build --mode mobile
scripts.mobile:native:client:android: npm run mobile:client:config && npm run build:mobile && npm run mobile:native:android:add && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs client android
scripts.mobile:native:guard:android: npm run mobile:guard:config && npm run build:mobile && npm run mobile:native:android:add && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs guard android
scripts.mobile:native:client:ios: npm run mobile:client:config && npm run build:mobile && npm run mobile:native:ios:add && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs client ios
scripts.mobile:native:guard:ios: npm run mobile:guard:config && npm run build:mobile && npm run mobile:native:ios:add && node scripts/configure-native-project.mjs guard ios
